notes.title: PLAY FOR FREE, FOREVER!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33965864/501b453e6c29b10ceadef6a0cb9b3c93e34ab2fb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Dear players![/h1]
Developing games is not simple.
Making Chaordic free, wasn't a simple choice, developing Chaordic, we paid more attention to it than anyone else when developing Chaordic.
We spent a half of year of not-stopping work. 
We planned: calling actors for vocalizing characters and dialogs. But it is not always possible to do the planned as it was originally prescribed. Most of the time was devoted to the creation of graphics. The difficult aspect of development was to keep the balance of the game. The game was originally conceived as a simple [platform jumper with random generation of platforms, its shape, color and features], but I could not resist and made a more complex game and distant from the initial idea. The larger the game in terms of functionality, the more it requires attention and careful adjustment to harmonize all aspects and functions of the game.

We thank all the players, who bought the game, and also information-gaming portals and bloggers for your supporting the game Chaordic. Your money were spent on developing the game Grove flowers and supporting Artepi Corporation. If you wouldn't buy Chaordic, it would be hard to develop other games. Thanks, pirates, for not hacking games.
Special thanks to all beta testers, difficult work has been done - during it, there were fixed 1.241 glitches thanks to 9 young and talented players. All the players are rewarded by sweet presents and keys of all developed games.

[b]Fun fact[/b]: during the first passage of the game, testers couldn't beat the 2 level, yet after 5 hours of attempts, we came to the conclusion that it is impossible to surpass the randomness of the game.
Now the balance of the game, is balanced less and now you can pass it till the end.

[b]We are sory for the inconvenience ,as compensation, everyone who bought Chaordic earlier, will get Grove of flowers for free, and backgrounds for desktop in 4k as an additional content(coming very soon).

Pay attention for the following things: evrn if you didn't like that game, please leave comments, type in Steam reviews and discussions. We need your attention!

Enjoy game process, and good luck!
[/b]

You can always contact us straight.

notes.title: Update v1.0.2.5800
notes.content:
[b]Added [/b]Partial gamepad support 45% (you cannot switch the menu).

[b]Balance[/b]
Increased viability percentage to 0.35
Increased intelligence to 0.17
Increased agility to 0.22

[b]Fixed [/b]localization in Russian, English.

[b]Minor change[/b]
Optimization. The load on the RAM is reduced by 70 mb.
Partial elimination of sound loss (possible if more than 150 daemons are affected)
